name: Karras (rho=7)
tagline: Power-law (ρ=7) noise schedule from EDM that concentrates steps in higher-noise regions.
diff_from_baseline: Karras et al. 2022 (EDM, NeurIPS). Inverse-power-law warp on noise levels; ρ=7 is the recommended default. Standard schedule for low-step EDM-style diffusion sampling.

name: Uniform (linear)
tagline: Evenly spaced time steps from t_max down to t_min via torch.linspace.
diff_from_baseline: Trivial linear interpolation of the bridge time variable. Default fallback schedule when no schedule research is performed.

name: Cosine (Nichol-Dhariwal)
tagline: Cosine warp that places denser steps in the mid-noise region where perceptual changes are largest.
diff_from_baseline: Nichol & Dhariwal 2021 (Improved DDPM, ICML). Smooth cosine schedule originally proposed for the noise variance ᾱ_t; here re-purposed as a (1-cos)/2 warp on bridge times.

name: Log-linear (geometric)
tagline: Geometrically spaced steps (uniform in log–σ) that emphasise low-noise resolution.
diff_from_baseline: Classic log-uniform / geometric schedule used by VP-style and score-based diffusion samplers; gives proportional density across decades of noise.
